summary: Minimal single-field setter: stores argument a2 into the dword field at this+0x0 and returns a2 as the result. No branching, no callees, no global access. Called by MIDI parsing and steward lifecycle helpers, so it likely writes a scalar state field (for example a counter or mode value) into a per-object struct.

operations.description: Write argument a2 into the caller's field at offset 0x0 of this.
Keep a2 as the function result value before the field write.
Return a2, matching the stored value.
